facts.fact: The Data Landscapers cable factsheet (AI-compiled, flagged as working analysis) lists three in-service cables landing in Kenya at Mombasa: EASSy, SEACOM and TEAMS (Mombasa to Fujairah); three routes, all at Mombasa.
The factsheet marks EASSy, landing at Mombasa, as open access (open_access yes); it is a largely African consortium led by WIOCC.
The factsheet marks SEACOM, landing at Mombasa, as open access (open_access yes).
The factsheet marks TEAMS, Mombasa to Fujairah and owned by the Government of Kenya, Kenyan operators and minority Etisalat, as open access (open_access yes).

note: 2Africa, Equiano, WACS, ACE, SAT-3 and MainOne are not stated to land in Kenya here; 2Africa's Kenya landing is not named.
